story.text: Jo, lying on the {SOFA}, pretends to read the newspaper. She has secretly sent it two {STORIES}, and now she reads one aloud, “The Rival {PAINTERS}”. Her sisters {PRAISE} it. “Who wrote it?” asks Beth. “Your sister!” Meg cannot believe it, Amy {CRITICISES} the artistic parts, and Marmee is very {PROUD}.
story.caption: Jo laid herself on the sofa and affected to read
